Our fleet of 16 boats — from sleek speedboats to superyachts — offers something for every group. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40, all-inclusive. Read on for everything you need to plan your weekend.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for F1 Weekend?

Marbella is the unofficial VIP hub for the Spanish Grand Prix. While the race is in Barcelona (1,000 km away), the real action for the jet set happens on the Costa del Sol. Chartering a yacht gives you a floating base to watch the race on board, cool off in the Mediterranean, and then head to Puerto Banús for dinner and dancing. You avoid the crowds and enjoy total privacy.

Puerto Banús is the epicentre of F1 weekend parties. After your charter, step off at the marina and hit clubs like Pangea or Olivia Valere. The Golden Mile is lined with restaurants and bars.
